description: This PHP source file defines the PerformanceTrackerLogDao class, which manages database interactions related to performance tracker logs in the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and filtering performance tracker logs based on various criteria.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling database operations related to PerformanceTrackerLog entities in the OrangeHRM performance plugin.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogById
methods.description: Retrieves a PerformanceTrackerLog entity by its ID if it exists and is not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getExistingPerformanceTrackerLogIdsForTrackerId
methods.description: Fetches IDs of existing performance tracker logs associated with specific tracker ID and given list of log IDs.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogsByTrackerId
methods.description: Retrieves performance tracker logs filtered by criteria encapsulated in PerformanceTrackerLogSearchFilterParams.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogQueryBuilder
methods.description: Constructs a query builder tailored for performance tracker logs filtering, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogsRateCount
methods.description: Counts the number of performance tracker logs with specific achievement ratings for a given tracker.

methods.name: savePerformanceTrackerLog
methods.description: Persists a PerformanceTrackerLog entity into the database.

methods.name: deletePerformanceTrackerLog
methods.description: Marks specified performance tracker logs as deleted by updating their status.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogIdsByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of performance tracker logs associated with a particular user.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogsIdList
methods.description: Gets IDs of all performance tracker logs where the associated employee has not been purged.
